thermal_time.method: single sine (Snyder 1985) over the daily curve

stages_note: R1, R3 and R7 are the OBSERVED median thermal requirement from observed NASS planting to blooming, setting pods and leaf drop (scripts 23-25). VE, R5, R6, R8 have no NASS counterpart and are unvalidated; they are retained for script 21 only

window.rule: both ends are regressions on observed NASS pod-setting and leaf-drop dates, moved by a county-relative driver anomaly
window.why: thermal time predicts late-season timing worse than the mean date (script 24), and a statewide GDD threshold puts thermal R3 absurdly late in cool northern county-years (script 25)

planting_rule.rule: first day with a 7-day mean at or above temp_c
planting_rule.note: anchored to the observed mean planting date; a statistical device, not a physiological threshold

water_balance.capacity: SSURGO available water, top metre, mm
water_balance.et0: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, humidity-responsive; Hargreaves retained in _pheno for comparison

shared_module: _pheno.py, also used by script 20 for CMIP6 scenarios
